This petition is filed seeking quashing of FIR No.98/2022 registered at P.S Moti Nagar under Sections 498A/406/34IPC on the basis of settlement dated 27th April 2024 arrived at between the parties, which is on record.
2. Petitioner nos.1 to 9 as also complainant/ respondent no.2 are present in Court, all of whom are duly identified by the IO, as also by the counsel.
3. Marriage of petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 was solemnised on 25th February 2021, which has since been dissolved by decree of divorce dated 24th May 2024.
No child is born out of the said wedlock.

4. As per settlement, a total of Rs. 10 lakhs is to be paid to respondent no.2, out of which Rs. 7 lakhs stands paid and balance amount of Rs. 3,00,000/- is tendered to respondent no.2 in Court today by way of Demand Draft No. 082906 dated 8th July 2024 drawn on Union Bank; which she accepts and acknowledges.
